patch_description: This version keeps the search centered on valid repaired candidates, then spends LP calls in small batches on varied degree-preserving moves. It uses bottleneck links to guide some switches and rotations, but reserves proposals for unrestricted moves and archive-guided changes so dual prices do not dictate the entire search. A compact, visit-adjusted archive balances exploiting strong networks with exploring less-visited regions; surrogate energy helps rank proposals without deciding which moves get tested on its own.
